# Kianna Lim — IT Student & Web Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Kianna Ivan Marie Lim, Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) student at Data Center College of the Philippines in Baguio City. Specializing in front-end web engineering, responsive user interfaces, and relational database systems (MySQL, PHP).

## Core Links

- [Portfolio Homepage](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/): Aesthetic minimalist portfolio featuring curated works, interactive tools, and sensory controls.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create): Source code repositories, database systems, and academic projects.
- [Portfolio Source Code](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create/portfolio): Open-source repository for Kianna's personal portfolio website.

## Featured Projects

- [Beyond the Brew POS & MIS](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/#work): Point of Sale and Management Information System designed with normalized MySQL relational schemas and real-time recipe inventory deduction.
- [Computer Rental & Sales System](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/#work): Relational database-backed terminal tracking and rental application developed with PHP 8, MySQL, and WampServer.
- [Personal Portfolio Website](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create/portfolio): Fast, responsive, accessible portfolio site built with semantic HTML5, modern CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and Web Audio micro-interactions. Live at [kanglimchu.netlify.app](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/).

## Technical Skills

- **Front-End Development**: HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, custom properties), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+, DOM manipulation, IntersectionObserver, Web Audio API).
- **Databases & Backend**: MySQL 8.0, 3NF Normalization, PHP 8.x, WampServer, CRUD operations.
- **Programming & Scripting**: Java, C#, Python.
- **Methodologies**: System Analysis and Design, responsive design, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.

## Education & Location

- **Institution**: Data Center College of the Philippines – Baguio City
- **Degree**: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)
- **Location**: Baguio City, Benguet, Philippines [16.4023° N, 120.5960° E]
